This script performs the cyp51 analysis. Make sure to install the required programs separately
```{r setup, include=FALSE, message=F}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
subdir_name <- "Rscripts/5_cyp51"
library(here)
```

```{r knit, echo = F,eval=F,warning=F,include=F}
seq_data = here::here("data/seq_data")
scripts = here::here("scripts")
results = here::here("results")
rmarkdown::render(input = here("scripts", str_c(subdir_name, ".Rmd")), output_dir = results_path)
```

# Cyp51 analysis

Here we look at SNPs and INDELs variant types in the regions encoding for cyp51a and cyp51b +1000 bp flanks.


The locations of the Cyp51 genes within the _A. tubingensis_ reference:

| Scaffold | Start | End | Locus Tag | Gene |
|:---|:---|:---|:---|:---|
| BLWE01000008 | 582526 | 584493 | AtWU_06533 | *cyp51A* |
| BLWE01000010 | 91551 | 93312 | AtWU_09124 | *cyp51B* |

The Cyp51A Insertion site is BLWE01000008:583109 

## Cyp51A
```{bash cyp51A,eval=FALSE}
bcftools view -r BLWE01000008:581899-585491 "$seq_data"/BLWE01000008_581899_585491.filteredSNPs.vcf.gz > "$results"/cyp51A_region.vcf
snpEff -hgvs1LetterAa Aspergillus_tubingensis_gca_013340325 "$results"/cyp51A_region.vcf > "$results"/cyp51A_annotated.vcf
bgzip "$results"/cyp51A_annotated.vcf -c > "$results"/cyp51A_annotated.vcf.gz
bcftools index "$results"/cyp51A_annotated.vcf.gz 
bcftools query -i 'ANN ~ "intron_variant" && ANN ~ "insC" && GT="alt"'  -f '[%SAMPLE\t%GT\n]' "$results"/cyp51A_annotated.vcf.gz
```

## Cyp51B
```{bash cyp51B,eval=FALSE}
bcftools view -r BLWE01000010:90551-94312 "$seq_data"/BLWE01000010_90551_94312.filteredSNPs.vcf.gz > "$results"/cyp51B_region.vcf
snpEff -hgvs1LetterAa Aspergillus_tubingensis_gca_013340325 "$results"/cyp51B_region.vcf > "$results"/cyp51B_annotated.vcf
bgzip "$results"/cyp51B_annotated.vcf -c > "$results"/cyp51B_annotated.vcf.gz
bcftools index "$results"/cyp51B_annotated.vcf.gz 
```

## Build substitution table
Use [3_extract_AA.py](scripts/3_extract_AA.py) to extract the variants. In snpEff database Cyp51A (AtWU_06533) has two additional exons compared to MH781351. To account for this, all substitutions are subtracted by 52 AAs, which results in the same mutations as found in MH781351. 
```{bash, eval=FALSE}
python3 "$scripts"/3_extract_aa.py cyp51A_annotated.vcf.gz AtWU_06533 52 > "$results"/cyp51a.mutations
python3 "$scripts"/3_extract_aa.py cyp51B_annotated.vcf.gz AtWU_09124 0  > "$results"/cyp51b.mutations
```
